high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of a tweet from the Twitter account @volcaholic1, which has a verified badge. The tweet was posted 21 minutes ago and reads: "Wow! A very bright fireball/meteor/bolide was spotted over Sweden, clearly visible from areas near Stockholm and the Åland Islands 🌟." Below this tweet, there is a reply from another user, @StrandenWX, who posted 27 minutes ago and says: "Another angle of the Meteorite/bolide across Åland Islands and Sweden's archipelago." The image attached to the tweet shows a bright meteor
